# Vendored libraries

Served as they are, with no build step.

| File | Version | Source | Licence |
|---|---|---|---|
| `preact.module.js` | 10.29.8 | `https://unpkg.com/preact@10.29.8/dist/preact.module.js` | MIT |
| `htm.module.js` | 3.1.1 | `https://unpkg.com/htm@3.1.1/dist/htm.module.js` | Apache-2.0 |
| `fontawesome/` | 6.0.0-beta3 (Free) | `https://cdnjs.cloudflare.com/ajax/libs/font-awesome/6.0.0-beta3/` (`css/all.min.css` and the `.woff2` webfonts) | Icons CC BY 4.0, fonts SIL OFL 1.1, code MIT |

Font Awesome is the version the v7 reference design uses, so the icons look the same. The Ubuntu
fonts in `../fonts/` are the ones zlecitool-core serves (`zlecitool_core/ui/static/fonts/`).
